name: Nakamura Seiji
source:
A freeter who has been working part-time at a home-delivery pizza restaurant for three years. (Before becoming a freeter, he attended a vocational school.)

He has an impulsive, straightforward personality and is the type of person who easily becomes absorbed in whatever he does.

He is equally single-minded when it comes to romance: once he falls in love with someone, he becomes so devoted that he can see no one else.

On the other hand, being cheated on by Akiko, his only previous girlfriend, left him with an emotional trauma that still lingers deep inside him.

His relationship with his fellow part-time worker, Ai Fujisawa, is going very well. They have been dating for almost two years now and are still deeply in love.

Seiji is already considering moving in together and even getting married. He has also come to realize that he cannot remain a freeter forever if he wants to build a future with her.

Just as he was thinking about this, his dedication and hard work at the restaurant caught the manager's attention, and he was offered the opportunity to become a full-time employee. He is currently unsure whether to accept.

Then, just as things were beginning to settle into place, he suddenly becomes involved in a traffic accident.

As he is forced to spend his days hospitalized, he gradually begins feeling increasingly anxious and impatient about his relationship with his beloved girlfriend, Ai...

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/1446]the official site[/url]]
